name: Mini Mini Anzu Club
original_name: ミニミニ あんず倶楽部
source:
Seven members of Anzu club sneak into school at night to solve seven school mysteries. Many surprises and possibly even love await them there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
安祖社的七名成员深夜潜入学校，解开学校的七大谜团。许多惊喜，甚至可能是爱情在那里等待着他们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
